primitives.label: Region proxy 01
assumptions: Axial depth 8 is a relative-unit prior, not measured depth.
Camera-aligned orientation and unseen dimensions are hypotheses.
Primitive geometry does not establish semantic identity.
Pixel residual uses projected primitive bounds; curved surfaces are tessellated.
One fixed-size shape is retained across the shot; fit_error_px is RMS of temporal edge/contour residuals.
Bounding boxes alone do not distinguish box, ellipsoid or capsule shape.
Trajectory positions and jumps are inferred from 2D association; no floor, contact or airborne state is measured.
